mutations.contract_domain: Capacity hints for safely constructed owned LineString coordinate slices
mutations.reason: Replacing length > threshold with length >= threshold changes only equality. Each Coordinate contains two float64 values and a CRS, so its element size exceeds the 16-byte wire width. A safely allocated coordinate slice cannot have the approximately MaxInt/16 elements required for equality: its backing allocation would exceed MaxInt bytes. All reachable comparisons and hints are identical. No unsafe fabricated slice is a supported geometry.

mutations.contract_domain: Integer capacity thresholds with WKB header 5 or EWKB header 9 on supported Go architectures
mutations.reason: Replacing the final numerator -4 with +4 adds eight before division by16. MaxInt is15 modulo16; for header5 or9 the original numerator remainders are6 or2 and the changed remainders14 or10. The integer quotient is identical, no numerator overflows, and all admission comparisons and capacity hints remain unchanged.
